name: Waitlist CTA Clicked
description: Fires when the hero or nav CTA button is clicked to open the waitlist form.

name: Waitlist Step 1 Submitted
description: Fires when a user successfully submits their name, email, and phone in step 1.

name: Waitlist Step 1 Failed
description: Fires when step 1 submission fails due to validation or API error.

name: Waitlist Step 2 Submitted
description: Fires when a user submits the optional survey questions in step 2.

name: Waitlist Step 2 Skipped
description: Fires when a user skips the step 2 survey by clicking Ikke nu.

name: Founder Video Played
description: Fires when the user clicks play on the founder video.

name: Waitlist Signup Confirmed
description: Fires server-side when the API confirms a successful waitlist signup.
